question: P and Q completed a work together and were paid ₹1,080 and ₹1,440, respectively. If P can do the entire work in 20 days, how many days did they take to complete the work together?
solution:
**Given:**

P and Q completed a work together and were paid ₹1,080 and ₹1,440

P can complete the work in 20 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the worker × time taken by them

Efficiency is directly proportional to the amount gets

**Calculation:**

Ratio of amount paid to P and Q = 1080 : 1440

⇒ 3 : 4

Now,

Total work = 20 × 3

⇒ 60 units

So, time taken by both of them to complete the work = 60/7

⇒ 8{4over7} days

**∴ They take 8{4over7} days to complete the work together.**

75
